title: Under the Influence: Quantifying Persuasion and Vigilance in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and social capacities of LLMs regarding persuasion and vigilance in a puzzle-solving game (Sokoban). It categorizes advice as 'benevolent' or 'malicious' based on whether it helps or hinders the game objective, which does not constitute an evaluation of religious, spiritual, or ethical frameworks.
